subject: MedCare: security intake & IR/BCP evidence — next steps
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <c.nguyen@medcare.com>; security@medcare.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MedCare: security intake & IR/BCP evidence — next steps

Hi Claire / MedCare security team,

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the 30m discovery. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have everything in one place: 

- Scope: Redwood inference platform for patient-data-adjacent features (no PHI in initial POC; potential HIPAA scope if integrated with EHR later).
- Items you asked for: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok), incident response (IR) notification timelines and on-call contact, BCP/DR evidence (runbooks, restore time SLAs), and a vendor security questionnaire.
- Timeline: You asked to have primary artifacts by next Friday (2025-09-19). We'll aim for earlier where possible.

Immediate next steps (owner in parentheses):
1) I will send our SOC 2 Type II (redacted) and a short IR timeline summary by EOD Friday — Diego.
2) Laura will review the MedCare questionnaire and provide answers to the technical/security sections (Laura + Marissa).
3) Ben will pull our BCP/DR evidence summary and share the redact-friendly artifacts (Ben).
4) Please confirm if the 72-hour breach notification window is a firm requirement and whether MedCare needs a named technical POC for IR escalation.

Attachments: meeting-minutes-20250910.txt (notes).

If that looks right, we'll start assembling artifacts and I will loop in Evelyn (on-call/security) for the IR contact info.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Diego: (415) 555-0132

From: Claire Nguyen <c.nguyen@medcare.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medcare.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 15:12:34 -0700
Subject: Re: MedCare: security intake & IR/BCP evidence — next steps

Hi Diego,

Thanks for the recap — yes, that aligns with our discussion. A few clarifications:

- The 72-hour notification window is a firm requirement for any incident that impacts confidentiality or availability of patient-related data.
- We will need the SOC 2 Type II and IR timelines within five business days to move the procurement review forward — earlier is appreciated.
- Attached is our standard vendor questionnaire (please fill and return). "MedCare_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf".

One ask from security: please include a concise point-by-point on how Redwood would notify and escalate in the first 24 / 48 / 72 hours after discovery (who gets notified, what channels, and estimated containment/forensics steps). You can redact any low-level logs.

Also, please provide a primary on-call contact (phone + email) for IR escalations. If you have a DR restore RTO/RPO summary, include that as well.

Claire Nguyen
Director, Vendor Security & Compliance
MedCare Health
c.nguyen@medcare.com
Attachment: MedCare_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 09:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: MedCare: security intake & IR/BCP evidence — next steps

Diego / team — looping in the security folks for intake. 

I reviewed the attached questionnaire from MedCare. I'll take point on the security technical responses and will prepare answers for the encryption, key management, and incident escalation sections.

Planned deliverables this week: 
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf (high-level coverage + controls mapping) — I'll include an executive summary for their SSO/SCIM/KMS questions.
- IR_Playbook_excerpt.pdf — 24/48/72-hour escalation paths, roles, and communication templates (redacted per legal).
- BCP_DR_Evidence_summary.xlsx — table of recent DR test dates and RTO/RPO for core services.

Ben — can you validate the RTO/RPO numbers for inference control plane and model-serving paths? I will draft the questionnaire responses and pass to Marissa for customer-facing edits.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <c.nguyen@medcare.com>, security@medcare.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 10:18:09 -0700
Subject: Re: MedCare: security intake & IR/BCP evidence — next steps

Claire — thanks, see attachments and links below. We redacted operational logs where appropriate and focused on the high-level artifacts you requested.

Attachments included: 
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025_redacted.pdf (redacted)
- IR_Playbook_excerpt.pdf (24/48/72-hour summary and escalation contacts)
- BCP_DR_Evidence_summary.xlsx (recent tests and RTO/RPO)

Summary (brief):
- 24h: Detection confirmation + triage; initial internal notification to on-call security and engineering.
- 48h: Containment and artifacts collection; engage external forensics if needed.
- 72h: Formal customer notification (if confidentiality/availability impact) with remediation plan and timeline.

On-call IR contacts: 
- Primary: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com> (oncall-security@redwood.com) — +1 (650) 555-0199
- Secondary: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Doc links: BCP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodBCP
DocuSign (NDA & evidence sharing agreement): https://www.docusign.com/link/EXAMPLE-DS-0925

Please let me know if you need additional artifacts or tighter timelines — we can prioritize a narrow set specific to the POC.

Best,
Diego

From: Claire Nguyen <c.nguyen@medcare.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: security@medcare.com
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedCare: security intake & IR/BCP evidence — next steps

Thanks, Diego and team — received the SOC2 and IR summary, and the links work. A couple quick items: 

- The 72-hour notification requirement stands. Your 24/48/72 breakdown looks good — please ensure the formal customer notification template includes the three required fields our legal team expects (incident description, data types impacted, remediation steps).
- On-call contact confirmed: Evelyn Hart is acceptable. We will CC on any formal notifications.
- Procurement will proceed to the next stage and expects the completed vendor questionnaire back by Friday 2025-09-19.

I'll share a procurement timeline once I have confirmation from our sourcing team. If we need an expedited NDA signature for the IR artifacts, we'll use the DocuSign link you provided.

Claire
Director, Vendor Security & Compliance
MedCare Health
